regret_policy.reference_feasible_selection: selected minus finite-set comparator; lower is better

analysis_policy.regret_quantity: worst-case reference hydraulic power in W

comparator.definition: best reference-feasible design in the declared eight-design by six-condition comparison set
comparator.limitations: Best-known only within the declared finite eight-design, six-condition set and periodic-cell scope; it is not a global optimum.

conclusion.does_not_establish: Customer acceptance, global optimality, full cold-plate behavior, transient/controller performance, scientific qualification, or LIVE readiness.
conclusion.establishes: Only the observed DEVELOPMENT results for the frozen finite set, models, methods, budgets, and evidence class.
conclusion.next_expansion: Run the capped counted-CFD plan after owner compute authorization; expand physical scope only after reviewing finite-set failure modes.

control_policy.assumption: An implementable supervisory controller receives a commanded or measured steady-state heat load and commands pump flow proportionally before each settled operating point.
control_policy.name: steady-state-feed-forward-flow-per-heat
required_limits: future owner-approved pump flow, pressure and slew limits
